# SAI AGRO INDUSTRIES

> Sustainable Agro & Bio-Crop Solutions for Indian Agriculture (https://saiagro.shop)

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://saiagro.shop/): Overview of bio-fertilizers, crop advisor, dosage calculator, and agronomy insights.
- [Products](https://saiagro.shop/products): Catalog of bio-fertilizers, plant growth promoters, chelated micronutrients, bio-fungicides, and soil conditioners.
- [Crop Solutions](https://saiagro.shop/solutions): Stage-by-stage crop nutrition schedules for Paddy, Wheat, Sugarcane, Cotton, Vegetables, and Fruits.
- [Dosage Calculator](https://saiagro.shop/calculator): Acreage-based input dosage calculator.
- [Agronomy Blog](https://saiagro.shop/blog): Educational farming guides and soil health articles.
- [R&D & Quality Control](https://saiagro.shop/rnd): Microbiology laboratory and quality assurance overview.
- [Dealership Network](https://saiagro.shop/dealers): Pan-India dealer and distributor enquiry.
- [About Us](https://saiagro.shop/about): Company profile, vision, and mission.
- [Contact Us](https://saiagro.shop/contact): Direct product and agronomy support enquiries.
